# 3D asset credits — Nexus Dominion combat scenes

The combat stage uses a handful of CC-licensed glTF assets sourced via
https://poly.pizza. Per CC-BY 3.0 we list the author and licence below.
CC0 assets are mentioned for completeness but require no attribution.

## Characters (public/assets/characters)

| Slot       | Asset                | Author          | Licence |
|------------|----------------------|-----------------|---------|
| warrior.glb | Knight              | Vaporworks      | CC-BY 3.0 |
| ranger.glb | Archer               | Poly by Google  | CC-BY 3.0 |
| mage.glb   | Witch                | Quaternius      | CC0       |
| rogue.glb  | Wren, the thief      | (poly.pizza)    | CC-BY 3.0 |
